description: Write the candidate's cover letter for one job with TrueInterview's cover-letter writer, grounded in their résumé and the posting, checked for invented facts and stock phrases. Give exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role; instruction is the candidate's own steer ("mention my Kafka migration"). It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance. Show the candidate the letter before it goes anywhere.
name: write_cover_letter
title: Write a cover letter for a job
